displayName: sedaia-api: Cloud Run container startup failures

documentation.content: Symptom: a sedaia-api Cloud Run container failed during startup. Inspect the affected revision logs, startup probe results, image digest, runtime service account, and application configuration. Roll back when the active revision cannot become ready promptly. Owner: __NOTIFICATION_OWNER__.

conditions.displayName: Cloud Run startup error logs detected

conditionThreshold.filter: metric.type="logging.googleapis.com/user/cloud_run_container_startup_failures" AND resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.label.service_name="sedaia-api" AND resource.label.location="us-central1"
